phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Supply Chain & Business Foundations — Explore supply chain careers, build business literacy, and develop analytical skills.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and SCM career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to supply chain career pathways including logistics, procurement, operations, demand planning, and global sourcing.

milestones.label: Explore operations and supply chain management
milestones.description: Introduction to operations management concepts including process design, capacity planning, quality management, and the role of supply chain in competitive business strategy.

milestones.label: Build financial literacy for supply chain professionals
milestones.description: Introduction to financial statements with emphasis on inventory valuation, cost of goods sold, and how supply chain efficiency impacts the bottom line.

milestones.label: Join APICS or ISM student chapter
milestones.description: Join the APICS (now ASCM) student chapter, ISM student chapter, or CSCMP Roundtable. Attend supply chain industry events, facility tours, and networking sessions.

milestones.label: Analyze global economic forces in supply chains
milestones.description: Examine how international trade, tariffs, transportation economics, and global sourcing decisions shape modern supply chains. Students analyze the economics of reshoring and nearshoring trends.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Logistics & Procurement — Build logistics management and strategic sourcing skills.

milestones.label: Master logistics and transportation management
milestones.description: Study transportation modes, warehousing, distribution network design, and logistics technology. Students analyze logistics optimization problems using simulation and routing software.

milestones.label: Learn strategic procurement and sourcing
milestones.description: Study strategic sourcing methodologies, supplier evaluation and selection, contract negotiation, and total cost of ownership analysis. Students develop sourcing strategies for case study organizations.

milestones.label: Tour regional distribution centers and manufacturing facilities
milestones.description: Participate in industry facility tours of regional distribution centers, manufacturing plants, and 3PL providers in the Greensboro-Triad region. Connect classroom concepts to real operations.

milestones.label: Analyze global supply chain networks
milestones.description: Study global supply chain design, international logistics, customs and trade compliance, and supply chain risk management. Students map a multinational company's global supply network.

milestones.label: Build supply chain analytics proficiency
milestones.description: Apply quantitative methods including forecasting, inventory optimization, and simulation modeling to supply chain problems. Students use Excel, Python, and supply chain software tools.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced SCM & Professional Certification — Master supply chain strategy, earn CSCP preparation, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master supply chain strategy and integration
milestones.description: Study end-to-end supply chain integration, S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning), demand-supply balancing, and supply chain digital transformation strategies.

milestones.label: Begin CSCP or CLTD certification preparation
milestones.description: Coursework aligned with ASCM CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional) or CLTD (Certified in Logistics, Transportation and Distribution) certification content. Students register for certification exams.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with a supply chain industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a mentorship with a supply chain director, logistics manager, or procurement specialist through CoBE networks or ASCM chapter. Monthly meetings focus on career development and industry trends.

milestones.label: Complete summer supply chain internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship in logistics, procurement, demand planning, or supply chain operations at a manufacturing company, retailer, or 3PL provider.

milestones.label: Study supply chain sustainability and resilience
milestones.description: Analyze supply chain sustainability practices, circular economy principles, carbon footprint reduction, and resilience strategies for disruption management. Students develop sustainability scorecards.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Complete capstone supply chain project, earn certification, and launch career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone supply chain consulting project
milestones.description: Collaborate with a client organization to diagnose supply chain challenges, conduct analysis, and deliver optimization recommendations including cost reduction, service improvement, or network redesign.

milestones.label: Complete salary negotiation and offer evaluation for SCM roles
milestones.description: Workshops covering compensation analysis, relocation evaluation, and offer comparison for supply chain management positions across industries. Develop personal compensation strategy.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and ASCM chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in SCM coursework, lead ASCM student chapter activities, and organize facility tours and industry speaker events for the supply chain community.

milestones.label: Develop industry-specific placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package targeting logistics, procurement, or operations management roles. Includes CSCP certification status, case competition results, and documented industry network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE SCM Exit Assessment and finalize career activation documenting job offers, certification completions, or graduate program admissions.
